$comment: THE SHOP ID IS BORROWED AND THIS IS THE ONLY LINE THAT HAS TO CHANGE. data/items/shops.json is not this build's file and six agents were writing to it at once, so opening a Crownspire row would have meant editing a file somebody else owned; the counter therefore opens "aureline_provisioner", which is the fullest and best-gated stock list in the game and reads correctly for a big old city with a ladder in it. Whoever adds a "crownspire_provisioner" row to shops.json needs to change one string here and nothing else.

lines: Two hundred and six years on this corner and we have never once had a wet floor.
Mind where you put your feet. What can I get you?
